// DEMO SETUP "Demo Complaint Emails": 14 deliberately messy resident emails (all people and addresses fictional).
const E = [
 ['Robot not working - Voortrekker & Durban, Bellville',
  `Hi,

The traffic lights at the corner of Voortrekker Road and Durban Road in Bellville have been completely off since about 7am. Cars are just going through and I nearly saw two taxis collide. Please send someone urgently.

Thabo Molefe
082 555 4410
thabo.molefe@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['traffic lights out!!',
  `lights at durban rd / voortrekker rd bellville are DEAD. total chaos, people jumping the intersection, someone is going to get killed. pls fix

- Priya Naidoo, 083-555-9012, priya.naidoo@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Verkeersligte werk nie - Bellville',
  `Goeie môre

Die verkeersligte by die kruising van Voortrekkerweg en Durbanweg in Bellville werk glad nie sedert vanoggend nie. Motors ry net deur en voetgangers sukkel om oor te steek. Stuur asseblief dringend iemand.

Groete
Johan Pretorius
082 555 7781
johanp@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Massive pothole Main Road Claremont',
  `Good afternoon,

There is a huge pothole outside 45 Main Road, Claremont (near the bus stop). It burst my tyre this morning and cyclists are swerving into traffic to avoid it.

Regards,
Sarah Jacobs
+27 72 555 3021
sarah.jacobs@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Re: pothole Main Rd',
  `Hi, reporting the pothole outside no. 45 Main Rd in Claremont again - it is getting bigger and full of water now.
Grant Williams
grant.w@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Zebra crossing faded - kids at risk',
  `Hello

The pedestrian crossing at AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road in Mitchells Plain has faded so badly you can't see it anymore. Hundreds of school children cross there every morning and the cars don't stop.

Shireen Petersen
0615550147
shireen.petersen@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Isibane sesitrato asisebenzi - Khayelitsha',
  `Molo

Isibane sesitrato kwi-Spine Road kufutshane ne-Lansdowne Road eKhayelitsha asisebenzi iiveki ezimbini ngoku. Kumnyama kakhulu ebusuku kwaye abantu abaninzi bahamba ngeenyawo apha. Nceda nisincede ngokukhawuleza.

Enkosi
Nomvula Mahlangu
073 555 0188
nomvula.m@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Stop sign knocked down Woodstock',
  `Hi there, the stop sign at Searle Street and Sir Lowry Road in Woodstock has been knocked flat, probably by a truck. Cars coming out of Searle St are not stopping at all.

Daniel Smith
+27 (0)21 555 3344
daniel.smith@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Pothole Belvedere Road',
  `Morning, there's a deep pothole on Belvedere Road in Claremont, just after the school. Not urgent but it's damaging cars.
Kevin Moore - kevin.moore@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['big hole in the road!!!',
  `there's a big hole in the road near the taxi rank, my car nearly fell in. please fix asap!!
Lindiwe
lindiwe.k@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Stormwaterdrein verstop - Athlone',
  `Hallo

Die stormwaterdrein by Klipfonteinweg naby Jan Smutsrylaan in Athlone is heeltemal verstop. Elke keer as dit reën staan die water oor die hele baan en motors swaai uit in die ander baan in.

Marlene Adams
marlene.adams@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Query about my rates account',
  `Good day, my municipal rates bill for October is double the usual amount. Can someone please check my account?
Peter Brown
peter.brown@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Damaged guardrail on the N2',
  `Hi, the guardrail on the N2 near Nyanga (by the Borcherds Quarry off-ramp) is badly damaged after an accident last night. Pieces are lying in the emergency lane.
Ahmed Khan, 084 555 6620, ahmed.khan@demo-resident.co.za`],
 ['Pothole Sea Point',
  `Hi, pothole outside 300 Main Road, Sea Point, in the left lane. Medium size.
Megan Botha, megan.botha@demo-resident.co.za, 076 555 1290`],
];
return E.map(([subject, body]) => ({ json: { subject, body } }));

## Demo setup (run once before the demo)
Sends 14 messy resident emails (English, Afrikaans, isiXhosa, duplicates, a non-road query, a national-road report, one with no location) to the demo inbox and creates busy blocks in the inspectors' calendar.
